# The unit-test files the Windows job runs (.github/workflows/windows.yml), and nothing else (w910, lothsahn 2026-10-10:
# "we only run windows and mac specific tests on those runners when needed"). Every test also runs on Linux in ci.yml;
# a file is here only when its Windows run exercises something Linux cannot: Windows PowerShell 5.1, cmd.exe, CIM,
# scheduled tasks, robocopy, rd, taskkill, named pipes, NTFS locks.
#
#   <test file> | <the production files it covers on Windows> | <why it needs Windows>
#
# windows.yml runs when a pull request touches a test or a covered file here (its paths list, checked against this file
# by scripts/windows-tests.test.ts). A test skipped everywhere but Windows must be listed here, or it would never run.
server/machineDeployWin.test.ts | server/machineDeployWin.ts, server/machineDeploy.ts, machine/** | Windows PowerShell 5.1 for real: the stop with Win32_Process and scheduled tasks, the probe, every script parsing in 5.1, the bootstrap under cmd.exe and PowerShell, install, the daemon saying hello as win32, uninstall; the tray app built with the in-box csc, its low-level input hooks and a SendInput key seen as injected (w1532)
server/machineDialogs.test.ts | server/watchdog.ts, scripts/unity-windows.ps1 | real WinForms windows listed and closed
server/republish.test.ts | scripts/republish-public.ps1, scripts/common.ps1 | Windows PowerShell 5.1 with Win32_Process (Get-Supervisor) and .cmd shims
server/updateSteps.test.ts | scripts/update-steps.ps1 | the portal host's updater under Windows PowerShell 5.1 with the real npm.cmd (Linux runs it under pwsh 7)
server/machineSandboxesEditors.test.ts | server/proc.ts, machine/sandboxes.ts | git worktrees copied with robocopy and removed with rd on NTFS
server/machineSandboxesLife.test.ts | server/proc.ts, machine/sandboxes.ts | git worktrees copied with robocopy and removed with rd on NTFS
server/machineSandboxesTrim.test.ts | server/proc.ts, machine/sandboxes.ts | git worktrees copied with robocopy and removed with rd on NTFS
server/copyTree.test.ts | server/proc.ts | copyTree's robocopy /XD and Copy-Item branches
server/hostWatch.test.ts | machine/hostWatch.ts | taskkill /T /F, and Windows locking a live process's folder
server/workerCaps.test.ts | machine/workerCaps.ts, machine/winJob.cs | the worker caps' job object for real (w5554): the helper built with Add-Type, a fork bomb refused past its active-process limit and a commit past its memory limit, and its tools ended while the host and its claude go on
server/unityReaper.test.ts | machine/unityReaper.ts | the process list from CIM
server/leftovers.test.ts | machine/leftovers.ts | another process's environment block read through Windows PowerShell 5.1 (Add-Type, the PEB): whose worker started it; the ff-leftovers shim under Git Bash, whose fork+exec breaks the Windows parent chain (w1222)
server/sandboxes.test.ts | server/sandboxes.ts | a file held without delete sharing gives EPERM
server/firefox.test.ts | machine/firefox.ts | real windows closed one at a time by WM_CLOSE (one that refuses stops it), the process list from CIM, a process ending on its own (w1593)
server/elevation.test.ts | server/elevation.ts | the real signed-in-desktop check through CIM
server/opsWorker.test.ts | server/opsWorker.ts | named pipes, as on the Windows portal host
server/orchestratorMemory.test.ts | server/orchestratorMemory.ts | the memory guard's Windows path rules on a real NTFS file system
server/junctionDelete.test.ts | server/proc.ts, server/cleanup.ts | a junction made by cmd /c mklink /J inside a folder: rd /s /q, the clean-up's fs.promises.rm, fs.rmSync and Remove-Item remove the junction and keep its target, as the worker prompt's Windows delete advice says (w6264)
server/cleanup.test.ts | server/cleanup.ts | path rules on a real Windows host, where a /-rooted path resolves under C: (abea9f5: a Windows-only bug this caught on a PR)
server/ownLeftovers.test.ts | server/ownLeftovers.ts | the clean-up plan on a real Windows file system
server/machineUnityMcp.test.ts | machine/sandboxes.ts | the real sandbox pool's Windows commands (realPoolDeps('win32'))
scripts/test-watchdog.test.ts | scripts/test-watchdog.ts, scripts/test-inflight-reporter.ts | the process list from CIM and taskkill /T when a run hangs
scripts/join.test.ts | scripts/worker/join.cmd, scripts/worker/join.ps1, server/machineJoinHttp.ts | the join installer double-clicked as cmd.exe runs it (CRLF, quoting, irm | iex in Windows PowerShell 5.1 with its code), and the join bootstrap under Windows PowerShell 5.1 (w1592)
scripts/instance-priority.test.ts | scripts/instance/new.ts | the start-portal.sh an instance runs, under Git Bash for real: its PowerShell 5.1 raise of the portal's CPU, I/O and memory priority with -EncodedCommand, and the portal's exit code kept (w6221)
scripts/updatePath.test.ts | machine/selfUpdate.ts, server/agentTools.ts, server/safeGit.ts, server/gitHooks/** | the update path on Windows for real (w5573): Git for Windows' system config (its TLS backend and credential manager) under the git fence, the server/gitHooks folder as core.hooksPath on an NTFS path, Git Bash's sh found for registerAgents.sh, a self-update checkout and the real fetches of ff-factory and final-factory-agents
server/transcriptLabels.test.ts | server/transcriptLabels.ts | real integrity labels (w5703): a Low node refused every write, plant, rename and delete of another conversation's transcript under the Medium projects folder and let into its own, the spawner's new-conversation gate against a stand-in CLI at Low, and the way back; skipped where the test process itself runs Low
server/toolsLabelsWin.test.ts | machine/lowIntegrity.ts, server/agentNode.ts | real integrity labels with icacls and a Low-labelled node (w5717): a Low worker could rename tools/node aside inside a Low tools folder, and cannot once tools is Medium with its other children Low on their own
machine/steamUpload.test.ts | machine/steamUpload.ts | Windows paths and fences for real (w5551): steamcmd's folder under the worker fence, the install and the run folders on NTFS, a symlink refused where the account can make one (w5725)
machine/playerCache.test.ts | machine/playerCache.ts | a player packed and installed with the real Windows tar (bsdtar) on NTFS paths (w5725)
server/agentTools.test.ts | server/agentTools.ts | a broken tools-medium checkout moved aside and cloned again on NTFS (w5776): a real git checkout renamed, and the older backup with its read-only git objects removed
server/workerFence.test.ts | server/workerFence.ts, machine/readFence.ts | the read fence's secrets folders and probe targets in Windows paths (drive-resolved, backslashes), and the macOS profile still built with POSIX joins on a Windows host (w5808: 9 tests failed locally on Windows that only the daily run met)
server/w5564PlayerFence.test.ts | machine/playerFence.ts | a player's writable folders answered in Windows paths (drive-resolved, backslashes), as timedRunner hands them to a player on every OS, and the macOS player fence's resolved temp on a Windows host (w5809: 2 tests failed locally on Windows that only the daily run met)
server/w5630MacEditorFence.test.ts | machine/unity.ts, server/workerFence.ts | the macOS editor fence and the licensing client's path still built with POSIX joins on a Windows host (w5809: 2 tests failed locally on Windows that only the daily run met)
server/storeLock.test.ts | machine/storeLock.ts, machine/lowIntegrity.ts | the store lock on Windows for real (w5614): the main clone's git folder labelled Medium, a Low cmd.exe refused writing its refs, config and objects while it writes its slot repo; then store_lock off relabels it Low and a Low git commit in a worktree of it goes through
server/agentNode.test.ts | server/agentNode.ts | the firewall check script run in Windows PowerShell 5.1 against stand-in NetSecurity cmdlets with BEAST's values (w5581): a rule from Any, tailnet, LocalSubnet, missing from the bulk read, and peers outside the tailnet
machine/readFenceGaps.test.ts | machine/readFenceWin.ts | the read fence on Windows for real (w5957): a Low node copy refused a folder labelled No-Read-Up and reading the given-back folder and file inside it, the warn probe on a mirror, and on's probe taking the labels off after a given-back file was rewritten by rename; skipped when the test itself runs Low (a fenced worker cannot set a Medium label)
machine/workerCopyJunction.test.ts | machine/workerCopy.ts, machine/playersBroker.ts, machine/slotCaches.ts | a junction made by cmd /c mklink /J, as a worker makes one (w6247): the daemon's link tests (lstat or the parent's Dirent, realpathSync.native) and the Low node copy see it and never write or walk through it
server/remoteGuard.test.ts | server/remoteGuard.ts, server/saveWork.ts, server/switchBranch.ts, server/safeGit.ts, server/gitHooks/**, scripts/testEnv.ts | a fenced push to a planted bare repository on Windows for real (w6273): git-lfs's pre-push hook from server/gitHooks run by Git for Windows' sh, its `ls-remote` to github.com with the system config's credential helper cleared by scripts/testEnv.ts (Git for Windows' helper-selector, a picker window nobody sees, hung it on LothDesktop), NTFS paths written with forward slashes
